thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGE: production inference cluster high error-rate (svc: /v1/generate) — severity: P2 — paged oncall Laura (oncall).
Laura (oncall): got it, joining bridge now. starting quick triage. any immediate customer-facing impacts?
Jon P.: seeing spike in 5xxs ~ 10:43 UTC, errors look like 'KV cache miss + OOM-ish' in logs. forwarding sample lines.
Maria G.: alerted a few customers on Slack already — they reported timeout errors on synchronous calls. not yet broad.
Laura (oncall): ack. I'm running /incident status and attaching the current autoscale status.
SupportBot: Customer tickets created: #C-5123, #C-5124. Notifying account owners.
Jon P.: quick grep on worker logs:
```
runtime: alloc failed: cannot reserve memory for quant kernel
worker-42: trace: evicting KV cache entry -> 1.2ms
rpc: downstream client timed out after 15s
```
Laura (oncall): sounds like memory pressure on a subset of nodes after a recent model rollout. rolling back model variant to v2b-canary on affected ASG.
Ops Lead: confirm rollback and set queue throttle to reduce concurrent requests to 40% for the cluster.
Laura (oncall): rollback started at 10:56 UTC. monitoring.
IncidentBot: Update: rollback completed on 4/6 nodes at 11:03 UTC. Error rate reduced by ~70%.
Samir V.: verifying customer traffic to ensure no residual throttles causing errors. running synthetic checks.
Maria G.: can we draft a quick status page blurb? customers are asking in support thread.
Jon P.: draft suggestion: "We experienced elevated error rates on /v1/generate due to a model rollout that increased memory pressure on the inference pool. We rolled back the model variant and implemented throttling; service is recovering. We are investigating root cause and will post an RCA."
Laura (oncall): +1, add ETA for RCA: "72 hours for initial RCA; full postmortem within 10 business days."
Ops Lead: agree. I'll own the status page update and publish in 15 mins.
Maria G.: I'll coordinate the customer messages — target: short note to impacted customers in the next hour, with commit to follow-up.
Samir V.: backend notes for RCA: collect kernel selection logs, memory allocation histograms, rollout orchestration events, and per-node KV cache sizes. Also include allocation flags used by the runtime at rollout time.
Jon P.: creating an action list in thread so we don't lose track:
- Ops-01: publish status page update (Ops Lead) — due 11:20 UTC.
- CS-01: send short impact note to impacted customers (Maria G.) — due 11:30 UTC.
- RCA-01: gather runtime logs & kernel traces (Jon P., Samir V.) — due 72h.
- Mitigation-01: evaluate cache eviction and quantization profiles to prevent recurrence (Laura, Eng-ML) — due 5 business days.
- Postmortem: schedule postmortem meeting and assign writers (Ops Lead) — due 2 business days.
Laura (oncall): adding temporary alert rule change: raise threshold for memory pressure alerts to avoid noisy paging while we stabilize. I'll revert after postmortem.
IncidentBot: Note: paging silence requested by Laura (oncall) — until 12:00 UTC.
SupportBot: Ticket owner assignments: #C-5123 -> Maria G., #C-5124 -> Jon P..
Maria G.: drafting customer note now. will include: what happened, affected endpoints, immediate mitigation, next steps + RCA ETA. pinging for review.
Jon P.: reviewed. small wording tweak: call out that some synchronous requests may have experienced timeouts and retries might succeed.
Laura (oncall): infra follow-up: need to repro with canary traffic profile. Samir, can you run a repro with same memory footprint?
Samir V.: will spin up a test rig with the v2b-canary variant and increased concurrent prefix lengths. ETA 4 hours for a reliable run.
Ops Lead: schedule for follow-up sync in 48 hours to check RCA progress and remediation implementation.
Maria G.: customer note ready. posting to customers and to status page draft. dropping into #customer-ops for final signoff.
IncidentBot: Status update published at 11:19 UTC.
Laura (oncall): monitoring shows 5xxs down to baseline. marking incident as 'mitigated'. we keep this thread for post-incident coordination.
Jon P.: starting log dump for RCA; will upload artifacts to the incident folder (S3 link to be added).
Ops Lead: assigning postmortem authors: Jon P. (technical lead), Maria G. (customer impact section), Laura (timeline and mitigations). Ops Lead will compile.
Maria G.: support will send follow-up summary to affected customers once RCA initial findings are ready. recommend offering 1:1 calls for largest accounts.
Samir V.: quick note — potential root cause hypothesis: model kernel selection combined with increased sequence length in recent test data caused KMalloc fragmentation -> occasional allocation failures. need to validate.
Laura (oncall): good. set owner mapping in the action list and close any open immediate tasks.
Ops Lead: I'll maintain the action tracker and update statuses here. please add any blockers.
Jon P.: uploading artifact bundle now: s3://redwood-incidents/2291234567/artifacts.tar.gz
SupportBot: Customer-facing follow-up template posted to #customer-ops. Maria, you can copy/paste.
Maria G.: sending targeted messages now. will also post an entry on status.redwood.ai with the mitigation summary.
IncidentBot: Incident marked mitigated. Postmortem scheduled for 2 business days from now at 15:00 UTC — invite sent.
Laura (oncall): thanks team. small retrospective note: consider adding a preflight step on canary rollouts that simulates KV cache pressure with production-like prefixes.
Ops Lead: noted. added to Mitigation-01. Closing live bridge, keeping thread open for follow-up updates. :white_check_mark:
